title: A goal clause that says a copy is never written gets a planted case for each command that writes
goal: Planning maps a goal clause of the form "X is never written" or "read-only" to a planted case for each command of the touched tool that writes (fetch, fetch --pin, push, add, add-remote), not only the one the item adds (SP-mguax5m3 review: ST-gbyfjgmq's check covered fetch in a plugin host while kbroot.py push still committed in the plugin copy, BG-syg4awkk)

run: import sys; s = open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md').read(); i = s.find('## plan'); j = s.find('## start'); sys.exit(0 if 'each command that writes' in s[i:j] else 1)
